mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases the cost of capital for corporations, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of observations when FEDFUNDS is above 0.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% (UNRATE > 4.5%) signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) and a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) indicate an inadequate monetary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market downturn (HOUST < 1200 thousand units) reduces consumer spending and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST is below 1200, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for PAYEMS predicting 5-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (INDPRO < 100) signals a weakening economy, reducing corporate earnings and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is below 100, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS > 450,000 million dollars) indicate robust consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS exceeds 450,000 million dollars, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A stagflationary environment (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and UNRATE > 4.5%) combines high inflation with high unemployment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to policy uncertainty.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and UNRATE > 4.5%, the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.
